description: Kenya - Access to drinking water in Bomet county is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Kenya Red Cross Society. The datasets show the access to drinking water sources in Bomet county as collected by the kenya red-cross society. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Kenya Red Cross Society. Its tags are water sanitation and hygiene-wash. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2023-03-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
